steps.content: [Flashback]

March, N.F. 84
Border Observation Lighthouse OT-N07 Training Grounds

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Everyone, starting today, <color=#fb9259>little Ceto</color> is officially a lighthouse keeper! Let's give her a proper welcome!
The line of lighthouse keepers stared at their new member drowning in an oversized uniform, exchanging uncomfortable glances in silence. Herbert pulled Fynn aside.

steps.speaker: Herbert
steps.content: Whoa, hold on. We agreed we'd care for her until she was ten, then find her a safe home. What's... what's she doing back here?

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: No one would take her. And frankly, she didn't want to go either. With tensions this high, who's going to adopt an orphan from an old battlefield? Her background is a question mark to them.

steps.speaker: Herbert
steps.content: But... but it's too dangerous here! The front line could shift any day. When it does, how are we supposed to protect a child?

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: That's why she's not a child here; she's a keeper. I'll teach her to protect herself. To fight. To survive what's coming.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Remember, she survived contamination as an infant. She has a natural gift for controlling <color=#fb9259>that thing</color>. She might just end up saving you one day.

steps.speaker: Herbert
steps.content: Oh, come on, I don't need a kid to... Ah, fine. She can stay. But I'm not letting her anywhere near—

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Why not?
A little head suddenly popped up between them.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Teach me. I want to join. I want to be like you.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Now that's the spirit! A lighthouse keeper never backs down. Come here, Ceto. Give me your hand.
The girl extended her hand with a solemn expression, watching as the captain placed a strangely-shaped dagger into her palm.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: You know the basics: logging signal fluctuations, monitoring the WhiteSands disaster zone, maintaining the water and ventilation systems, cleaning the base in time... But that's not what makes a true keeper.
Fynn gently raised the girl's wrist, pointing forward. At the edge of the vast white expanse of WhiteSands, a tiny Sun floated on the horizon.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Look up. Look out at the horizon.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: You have to believe a better world is waiting out there. Stand facing it, fight for it, and never, ever let the lighthouse beacon go out.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: A better world... Can I really go?

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Absolutely. We'll all go back together. As heroes, returning to DisCity in glory!
[End of Flashback] [Beach, Daytime]
A mountain of monster carcasses rises from the shore, a testament to the night's grim work.
The lighthouse keeper stands at the heart of this sea of corpses, slowly lifting her head toward the distant horizon. Dawn has broken again.
The fragments on her dagger settle into silence. Surviving the Black Tide for the 2,019th time brings no sense of victory, only a profound exhaustion that has nothing to do with the fight.

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: ...Status report: Lighthouse OT-N07. One keeper remaining. No abnormalities observed...
She recites, the words a hollow habit. As she walks toward shore, a detail pierces the fog of her fatigue.

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: ...Report addendum. Lighthouse Seven, 2300 hours last night, a suspicious individual made landfall.
She kicks open the lighthouse's damaged iron door and searches the base cabin. It is empty. There's no trace of the suspicious individual in sight.
The only sign of the intruder is a thin trail of footprints on the stairs, marked with seawater and blood, leading up from the base.
